<title level="1" right="Rules">[Talismans](/Rules.aspx?ID=249)</title>

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 293 <sup>4.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">
<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">
A talisman is a special, single-use item you affix to your armor, a weapon, or elsewhere, allowing you to activate the talisman later for a special benefit. For more on talismans, see page 565.

 [_Potency Crystal_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=231)
</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>
